title: The Green Typewriter
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The green typewriter in the second-hand shop types what it hears — the next morning\'s secrets. When it types a name that belongs to the town\'s beloved baker, who dies that same day, retired secretary Dottie Lamb must decide whether the typewriter is a witness, a suspect, or a grief-stricken machine telling the truth.
